leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that calculates the expected sum of a complete sequence of numbers.
Apply a loop to compute the actual sum of a given array of integers.
Construct a solution that returns the missing number by comparing expected and actual sums.
Manipulate array inputs to handle edge cases such as empty or single-element arrays.
Initialize and update variables to track sums during iteration.
Integrate the missing number function into a testable code structure.
Control the function's logic to correctly identify the missing integer in O(n) time.
